# Picsellia

> Picsellia is an end-to-end MLOps platform built specifically for computer vision teams. Instead of stitching together separate tools for data management, annotation, model training, deployment, and production monitoring, Picsellia keeps every stage of the pipeline in one system with shared lineage from raw image to production prediction.

Picsellia is ISO 27001 certified and supports on-premise or hybrid deployment for teams with strict data residency or compliance requirements. It's used across manufacturing, agriculture, energy, waste management, aerospace, and defense.

## Platform

- [Product Overview](https://www.picsellia.com/product-overview): What a computer vision platform is and how Picsellia's five stages fit together
- [Datalake](https://www.picsellia.com/datalake): Centralized storage and organization for images and video at scale
- [Dataset Management](https://www.picsellia.com/dataset-management): Versioning and organizing datasets used to train models
- [Labeling Tool](https://www.picsellia.com/labeling-tool): AI-assisted annotation — bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation, keypoints
- [Annotation Campaigns](https://www.picsellia.com/annotation-campaigns): Structured labeling workflows with review and quality control
- [AI Laboratory](https://www.picsellia.com/ai-laboratory): Experimentation environment for training computer vision models
- [Experiment Tracking](https://www.picsellia.com/experiment-tracking): Reproducible experiment and model versioning
- [Automated Pipelines](https://www.picsellia.com/automated-pipelines): Automating retraining and data processing workflows
- [Model Deployment](https://www.picsellia.com/model-deployment): Shipping models to cloud, edge, or on-premise infrastructure
- [Model Monitoring](https://www.picsellia.com/model-monitoring): Production drift detection and performance monitoring

## Industries

- [Manufacturing](https://www.picsellia.com/industry/manufacturing): Computer vision for quality control, defect detection and visual inspection on production lines
- [Energy](https://www.picsellia.com/industry/energy): Computer vision for energy infrastructure inspection, predictive maintenance and asset monitoring
- [Agriculture](https://www.picsellia.com/industry/agriculture): Computer vision for crop monitoring, disease detection and precision farming
- [Waste Management](https://www.picsellia.com/industry/waste-management): Computer vision for automated waste sorting, recycling and material recognition
- [Aerospace](https://www.picsellia.com/industry/aerospace): Computer vision for aircraft inspection, component wear analysis and FOD detection in MRO workflows
- [Defense](https://www.picsellia.com/industry/defense): Secure, on-premise computer vision for surveillance, threat detection and situational awareness

## Customer stories

- [PellencST](https://www.picsellia.com/use-cases/pellencst): Cut time-to-model by 90%, from 6 to 9 months down to 1 month, for AI-powered waste sorting machines
- [Altaroad](https://www.picsellia.com/use-cases/altaroad): Saved 50% of time operating models in production, cutting model maintenance from 50% to 10% of data scientist time
- [SGS](https://www.picsellia.com/use-cases/sgs): Cut model development time by 66%, from 3 days to 1 day, for testing, inspection and certification workflows
- [Ficha](https://www.picsellia.com/use-cases/ficha): 3x faster annotation and 20% weekly time savings for waste classification and recycling AI
- [Abelio](https://www.picsellia.com/use-cases/abelio): 48-hour retraining cycles from image acquisition to farmer insights, on dozens of terabytes of drone imagery

## Guides

- [MLOps for Computer Vision: The Complete Guide](https://www.picsellia.com/post/mlops-for-computer-vision-complete-guide): What CVOps means and how the six stages of a computer vision pipeline fit together in production
- [Roboflow Alternatives for Enterprise Computer Vision Teams](https://www.picsellia.com/post/roboflow-alternatives-for-enterprise-computer-vision-teams): The alternatives teams evaluate once they need enterprise deployment, on-premise infrastructure or a full MLOps pipeline
- [Learn Computer Vision: Beginner's Guide](https://www.picsellia.com/post/resources-computer-vision-beginner-guide): Resources for learning computer vision, from OpenCV tutorials to online courses
- [Top Datasets for Computer Vision](https://www.picsellia.com/post/public-datasets-computer-vision): A guide to the main public datasets used in computer vision
- [Best Object Detection Datasets](https://www.picsellia.com/post/object-detection-datasets): Public datasets for training object detection models
- [Top Computer Vision Datasets for Manufacturing](https://www.picsellia.com/post/manufacturing-datasets): Datasets for manufacturing AI and visual inspection projects
- [COCO Evaluation Metrics Explained](https://www.picsellia.com/post/coco-evaluation-metrics-explained): Precision, recall, IoU and the COCO metrics used to evaluate object detection
- [Image Embeddings Explained](https://www.picsellia.com/post/image-embeddings-explained): What image embeddings are and how they reduce high-dimensional image features to vectors
- [DINOv2 Explained Step by Step](https://www.picsellia.com/post/dinov2-steps-by-steps-explanations-picsellia): How DINOv2 applies self-supervised learning to Vision Transformers for all-purpose visual features
- [Best Practices for Fine-Tuning Computer Vision Models](https://www.picsellia.com/post/best-practices-for-fine-tuning-computer-vision-models): Hyperparameter tuning best practices, shown on a typical computer vision task

## Key facts

- ISO 27001:2022 certified
- Deployment: SaaS, EU hosting, on-premise on Kubernetes or Docker, air-gapped
- Imports CVAT XML, CVAT for video, COCO, YOLO and Pascal VOC
- Python SDK and full API
- [Enterprise](https://www.picsellia.com/enterprise) and [Security](https://www.picsellia.com/security) pages
